name: VolumeSource
definition: A class for rendering data from a volumetric data source (e.g., sphere, cylinder, or entire computational domain). Provides the framework to decompose an arbitrary yt data source into bricks that can be traversed and volume rendered.
summary: VolumeSource is a yt rendering primitive that decomposes volumetric data into bricks for traversal, distinguished by its high-level framework and reliance on the embree ray-tracing engine.
